about.label: 01 / THE PERSON
paragraphs: I am Kaveeth Manodhya, an Applied Sciences undergraduate at Wayamba University of Sri Lanka with a strong interest in programming, technology, and creative media. I enjoy turning ideas into useful digital experiences, from developing websites and working with software to finding fresh ways to solve technical problems.

Beyond coding, photography and visual storytelling are an important part of what I do. Through my creative work, I explore composition, editing, design, and the details that make an experience memorable. I am always learning, experimenting with new tools, and finding ways to bring technical thinking and creativity together.
